{{Top}}
An '''ion trail''' was a detectable byproduct created by [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] or [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]]. It could be tracked by sensors to determine the direction a ship had traveled. Ships that were equipped with a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] were able to mask this trail, either by dissipating it or storing engine emissions to be released at a later point.

==Behind the scenes==
Ion trails are used in most space sci-fi genres to various effects. ''[[Star Wars]]'' ships can only locate a direction of travel, while ''Star Trek'' ships can sometimes identify a class of vessel or which race produced the vessel simply by the ion trail it produces.
